Zulu: Baphinde bafuna ukwazi ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwebhange, okusho ukuthi ukuhlola abantu abaningi ngokungahleliwe, kuthola ngempumelelo abantu abangenazimpawu.
Hausa: Sun kuma so sanin ko gwajin bargo, wanda ke nufin gwada mutane da yawa kara zube, yana samun mutanen marasa alamar cutar yadda ya kamata.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba be ba nyaka go tseba ge e ba diteko tša batho ba bontši, tše di šupago go dira diteko go batho ba bantši ntle le kgethollo, go tloga go thuša go hwetša batho bao ba se nago maswao.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ የጅምላ ምርመራዎች ማለትም ብዙ ሰዎችን በአንዴ በዘፈቀ መመርመር የበሽታ ምልክት የሌለባቸውን ግለሰቦችን በሚገባ ለይቶ ያወጣል፡፡

Source: The researchers created a computer model that predicts how people go from being susceptible to exposed, infected, and isolated.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakola omutetenkanyirizo gwa kompyuta ogulaga engeri abantu gye bava mu mbeera y’okusobola okusiigibwa ne badda mu mbeera y’okusiigibwa, ne balwala, ate ne baawulibwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà ṣẹ̀dá módẹ́ẹ̀lì kọ̀m̀pútà tó ń sọtẹ́lẹ̀ nípa bí àwọn ènìyàn ṣe máa ń lọ láti ìfaragbá sí ìyàyègbà, ìkóràn, àti ìyàsọ́tọ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi benze imodeli yekhompiyutha ebikezela ukuthi abantu bahamba kanjani ekubeni sengozini yokudalulwa, ukutheleleka, kanye nokuhlukaniswa.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ƙirƙiri samfurin kwamfuta wanda ke yin hasashen yadda mutane masu raunin kamuwa da cutar, da kuma warewa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hlamile mmotlolo wa khomphutha wo o akanyago ka moo batho ba tlogago seemong sa go gononwela go ya go sa go lebana le seemo, go fetetšwa, le go beelwa thoko.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ሰዎች ተጋላጭ ከመሆን ወደመጋለጥ ከዛ ኢንፌክት ወደመደረግ እና ተገሎ ወደመቀመጥ እንዴት እንደሚሄዱ የሚተነብይ የኮምፒውተር ሞዴል ሰርተዋል፡፡

Source: They focused on data from the Lusaka province in Zambia, which is a corporate hub with an international airport that borders two countries.
Luganda: Beemaliza ku byakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu bbendobendo lya Lusaka mu Zambiya, ekitundu ky’abakungu omuli n’ekisaawe ky’ennyonnyi ekyensi yonna ekiri ku nsalo z’amawanga abiri.
Yoruba: Wọ́n gbájúmọ́ dátà láti agbègbe Lusaka ní Zambia, kí í ṣe gbùgbun káràkátà tó ní ibùdókọ̀ òfurufú tó pín ibodè pẹ̀lú ìlú méjì.
Zulu: Bagxile olwazini oluvela esifundazweni saseLusaka eZambia, okuyisizinda sebhizinisi esinesikhumulo sezindiza samazwe ngamazwe esisemngceleni wamazwe amabili.
Hausa: Sun mayar da hankali ne kan bayanai daga lardin Lusaka na ƙasar Zambiya, wanda cibiyar haɗaka ce da filin jirgin sama na ƙasa da ƙasa da ke iyaka da ƙasashen biyu.
Northern Sotho: Ba beile šedi go datha ya go tšwa profenseng ya Lusaka go la Zambia, e lego mothopo wa tša kgwebo wo o nago le boemofofane bja boditšhabatšhaba bjo bo abelanago mellwane le dinaga tše pedi.
Amharic: የራሱ አለም አቀፍ ኤርፖርት ካለው ፣ከሁለት ሃገሮች ጋር ድንበር ከሚጋራው እና የኮርፕሬት ማእከል ከሆነው የዛምቢያ ሉሳካ አውራጃ በተገኘ መረጃ ላይ አተኩረዋል፡፡

Source: Because the characteristics of COVID-19 seemed to vary from place to place, they looked at 4 scenarios, where either 50% or 70% of COVID-19 cases were asymptomatic, and these cases were either equally or half as infectious as symptomatic ones.
Luganda: Olw’okuba ng’obubonero bwa COVID-19 bwalabika nga bwawukana okuva mu kifo ekimu okudda mu kirala, baatunuulira embeera 4, omwali abalwade ba COVID-19 ebitundu 50% oba70% abatalaga bubonero ate ng’abalwadde abo baali basiigira ddala ng’abo abalaga obubonero oba nga basiiga okutuuka ku kigero ekyawakati eky’abo abalag obubonero.
Yoruba: Nítorí àbùdá COVID-19 dà bí i pé ó máa ń yàtọ̀ láti ibikan sí ibòmíràn, wọ́n wo ìfiwé ìgbàṣẹ̀lẹ̀ 4, níbi tí yálà ìdá 50% sí 70% ẹ̀su àrun COVID-19 ti jẹ́ ti àwọn ẹni àìfàmìàìsàn hàn, àti pé àwọn ẹ̀sun àrùn yí wà ní ìdọ́gbà tàbí àbọ̀ ìkóràn sí àwọn tí ó ń fi àmì àìsàn hàn.
Zulu: Ngenxa yokuthi izici ze-COVID-19 zazibonakala zihluka ngokwezindawo, babheke izimo eziwu-4, lapho okungaba ngu-50% noma u-70% wamacala e-COVID-19 ayeyi-asymptomatic, futhi lawa macala ayelingana noma uhhafu ayethelelana njengalawo anezimpawu.
Hausa: Saboda halayen COVID-19 da alama sun bambanta daga wuri zuwa wuri, sun kalli yanayi guda 4, inda ko dai kashi 50% ko 70% na masu COVID-19 ba su da alamar cutar, kuma waɗannan lamuran sun kasance daidai ko rabin masu yaɗa cutar kamar marasa alamar cuta.
Northern Sotho: Ka lebaka la gore maswao a COVID-19 a laetša a fapana go ya ka mafelo, ba lebeletše diponagalo tše 4, moo go ka bago go bile le 50% goba 70% tša malwetši a COVID-19 a batho bao ba sa laetšego maswao, gomme malwetši ao e ka ba a be a fetela ka botlalo goba gannyane go swana le ao a laetšago maswao.
Amharic: የኮቪድ-19 ባህሪያት ከቦታ ቦታ የሚለያዩ ስለሚመስሉ 4 ክስተቶችን ለይተው አይተው ነበር፣ እነዚህም ወይ ከ50% እስከ 70% የኮቪድ-19 ክስተቶች የበሽታ ምልክት የሌለባቸው ነበሩ እና እነዚህ ክስተቶች የበሽታ ምልክት ካላቸው ጋር በእኩል ወይም በግማሽ ደረጃ ኢንፌክሽን አስተላላፊ ነበሩ፡፡

Source: The researchers’ model found that it was possible to control the spread of COVID-19 by performing blanket tests and by isolating all people who tested positive, even those without symptoms.
Luganda: Omutetenkanyirizo gw’abanoonyereza gwazuula nti kyali kisoboka okuziyiza okusaasaana kwa COVID-19 nga bakola okukebera okwa bonna wamu n’okwawula abantu bonna abaakeberebwa ne babasanga nga balina obulwadde ne bwe baabanga tebalaze bubonero.
Yoruba: Módẹ́ẹ̀lì àwọn olùṣèwádìí ṣàwárín pé ó ṣeéṣe láti dín ìtàkálẹ̀ COVID-19 kù nípa ṣíṣe àyẹ̀wo bíláńkẹ́ẹ̀tì àti nípa ṣíṣe ìyàsọ́tọ̀ àwọn ẹbi tó ní àìsàn náà láì ní àmì àìsàn.
Zulu: Imodeli yabacwaningi ithole ukuthi kungenzeka ukulawula ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19 ngokwenza izivivinyo zengubo nangokuhlukanisa bonke abantu abahlolelwe ukuthi banalo, ngisho nalabo abangenazo izimpawu.
Hausa: Samfurin masu binciken ya gano cewa yana yiwuwa a sarrafa yaɗuwar COVID-19 ta hanyar yin gwajin bargo da kuma ware duk mutanen da suka kamu, har ma da waɗanda ba su da alamun cutar.
Northern Sotho: Mmotlolo wa banyakišiši o utollotše gore go be go na le kgonagalo ya go laola phatlalalo ya COVID-19 ka go dira diteko tša batho ka bontši le ka go beela ka thoko batho bao ba hweditšwego ba na le phetetšo, go akaretšwa le bao ba se nago maswao.
Amharic: የተመራማሪዎቹ ሞዴል እንዳገኘው የኮቪድ-19 ስርጭትን የጅምላ ምርመራዎች በማድረግ እና ፖዘቲቭ ሆነው የተገኙ ግለቦችን እና ምልክት የሌለባቸውን ሳይቀሩ አግልሎ በማስቀመጥ መቆጣጠር ይቻላል፡፡

Source: They said that to have reduced the peak number of cases by 90% across all scenarios, 10% of the people in Lusaka needed to be tested every day.
Luganda: Baabamba nti okusobola okukendeeza ku muwendo gw’abalwadde ogwali waggulu ku bitundu 90% mu mbeera zonna, ebitundu 10% eby’abantu mu Lusaka baali balina okugemebwa buli lunaku.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní wọ́n ṣe ìdínkù sí ẹ̀sun àrùn pẹ̀lú ìdá 90% káàkiri ìgbàṣẹ̀lẹ̀, ìdá 10% àwọn ènìyàn ní Lusaka nílò láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò lójojúmọ́.
Zulu: Bathe ukuze kwehliswe isibalo esiphezulu samacala ngo-90% kuzo zonke izimo, u-10% wabantu baseLusaka udinga ukuhlolwa nsuku zonke.
Hausa: Sun ce don rage ƙololuwar adadin masu cutar da kashi 90% a duk al'amuran, kashi 10% na mutanen Lusaka na buƙatar a gwada su a kowace rana.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore go kgonthiša gore palo ya godimodimo ya malwetši e fokotšega ka mo go bonalago ka 90% go diponagalo ka moka, 10% tša badudi ba Lusaka go be go hlokega gore ba dirwe diteko letšatši ka letšatši.
Amharic: በሁሉም ክስተቶች ከፍተኛውን የክስተት ቁጥር በ90% ለመቀነስ 10% ያህል የሉሳካ ሰዎች በየቀኑ መመርመር ነበረባቸው፡፡

Source: They also found that if we wanted to keep the number of new COVID-19 infections constant, 22% of people needed to be tested every day.
Luganda: Era baazuula nti oba nga twali twagala okukuuma omuwendo gw’abalwadde ba COVID-19 nga tegukyuka, abantu ebitundu 22% baali baina okukeberwa buli lunaku.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ri pé láti ṣe ìpamọ́ ọ̀ǹkà ìkóràn COVID-19 tuntun, ìdá 22% àwọn ènìyàn ló ní láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò lójojúmọ́.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola ukuthi uma sifuna ukugcina isibalo sabantu abasha abangenwa yi-COVID-19 singashintshi, ama-22% abantu adinga ukuhlolwa nsuku zonke.
Hausa: Sun kuma gano cewa idan muna son tsayar da adadin sababbin cututtukan COVID-19 a tsaye, kashi 22% na mutane suna buƙatar a gwada su a kowace rana.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gape le gore ge e ba re be re nyaka gore palo ya diphetetšo tše mpsha tša COVID-19 e se fetoge, 22% tša batho go be go hlokega gore ba dirwe diteko letšatši ka letšatši.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ አዳዲሶቹን የኮቪድ-19 ኢንፌክሽኖች ወጥ አድርገን ማቆየት ከፈለግን 22% ያህል ሰዎች በየቀኑ መመርመር አለባቸው፡፡

Source: Despite Zambia putting many COVID-19 limiting measures in place, the cases still seemed to rise.
Luganda: Weewaawo Zambiya yateekawo ebiyamba okukugira, obulwadde bwa COVID-19 era bwafaanana okweyongera.
Yoruba: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé Zambia ń ṣe ohun gbogbo láti dín COVID-19 kù, àwọn ẹ̀sun àrun náà ń pọ̀ si.
Zulu: Yize iZambia ibeke izindlela eziningi zokukhawulela i-COVID-19, amacala abebonakala enyuka.
Hausa: Duk da cewa Zambiya ta sanya matakan iyakance COVID-19 da yawa a wurin, har yanzu kamuwar tana tashi.
Northern Sotho: Le ge Zambia e be e beile mapheko a mantši a go thibela phatlalatšo ya COVID-19, malwetši a ile a tšwela pele go hlatloga.
Amharic: ዛምቢያ ብዙ ኮቪድ-19ን የሚገድቡ እርምጃዎችን ብትዘረጋም ክስተቶቹ ግን እየጨመሩ የሚሄዱ ይመስላሉ፡፡

Source: Blanket testing effectively reduced the number of COVID-19 cases by 90% in a small town in Italy.
Luganda: Okukebera okwa bonna kwakendeeza omuwendo gw’abalwadde ba COVID-19 n’ebitundu 90% mu kabuga akatono mu Yitale.
Yoruba: Àyẹ̀wo bíláńkẹ́ẹ̀tì ń ṣe àdínkù sí ẹ̀sun àrun COVID-19 pẹ̀lú 90% ní ìlú kékeré kan ní Italy.
Zulu: Ukuhlolwa kwengubo yengubo kwehlise ngempumelelo inani lamacala e-COVID-19 ngo-90% edolobheni elincane lase-Italy.
Hausa: Gwajin bargo yadda ya kamata ya rage adadin COVID-19 da kashi 90% a wani ƙaramin gari a ƙasar Italiya.
Northern Sotho: Go dira diteko tša batho ka bontši go fokoditše palo ya malwetši a COVID-19 ka 90% toropong ye nnyane nageng ya Italia.
Amharic: በጣልያን በትንሽ ከተማ ውስጥ የጅምላ ምርመራዎች የኮቪድ-19 ክስተቶችን በተሰካ መልኩ በ90% ቀንሰውታል፡፡

Source: But, there are no previous studies to suggest it would be effective in a large city elsewhere.
Luganda: Wabula, tewali kunoonyereza kwali kukoleddwa kulaga nti kisobola okukola ewalala mu kibuga ekinene.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n, kò sí ìmọ̀ àtẹ̀yìnwá láti dábàá pe yóò ṣiṣẹ́ ní àwọn agbègbè ńlá mìíràn.
Zulu: Kodwa, azikho izifundo zangaphambilini eziphakamisa ukuthi kuzosebenza kahle edolobheni elikhulu kwenye indawo.
Hausa: Amma, babu wani bincike na baya da ya nuna cewa zai yi tasiri a babban birni a wani wuri.
Northern Sotho: Eupša ga go na dinyakišišo tša peleng tšeo di laetšago gore seo se tla šoma ka tshwanelo go toropo ye kgolo go gongwe.

Source: Note that the researchers did not actually do blanket testing in this study; rather they created a model that suggests blanket testing would work to limit COVID-19 spread in larger cities.
Luganda: Kigenderere nti abanoonyereza mu kunoonyereza kuno tebaakola kukebera kwa bonna; wabula, baateekawo omutetenkanyirizo ogulaga nti okukebera okwa bonna kuyinza okuyamba mu kuziyiza okusaasaana kwa COVID-19 mu bibuga ebinene.
Yoruba: Mọ̀ pé àwọn olùṣèwádìí kò ṣe àyẹ̀wo bíláńkẹ́ẹ̀tì nínú ìádií yìí; dípò bẹ́ẹ̀ wọ́n ṣe módẹ́ẹ̀lì tó dábàá pé àyẹ̀wo bíláńkẹ́ẹ̀tì yóò ṣiṣẹ́ láti dín ìtàkálẹ̀ COVID-19 kù ní àwọn ìlú ńlá.
Zulu: Qaphela ukuthi abacwaningi abazange benze ukuhlolwa kwengubo kulokhu cwaningo; kunalokho badale imodeli ephakamisa ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwengubo kungasebenza ukunciphisa ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19 emadolobheni amakhulu.
Hausa: A lura cewa masu binciken a zahiri ba su yi gwajin bargo ba a cikin wannan binciken; maimakon haka, sun ƙirƙiri samfurin da ke nuna gwajin bargo zai yi aiki don iyakance yaɗuwar COVID-19 a cikin manyan biranen.
Northern Sotho: Lemoga gore banyakišiši ga se ba dira diteko tša batho ka bontši ka dinyakišišong tše; eupša ba hlamile mmotlolo wo o šišinyago gore diteko tša batho ka bontši e ka ba tharollo ya go fokotša phatlalalo ya COVID-19 go ditoropokgolo.
Amharic: እዚህ ጋር ታሳቢ መሆን ያለበት ተመራማሪዎቹ የጅምላ ምርመራዎችን በዚህ ጥናት አላካሄዱም ነበር፤ ይልቁንስ በትልቅ ከተማዎች ውስጥ የጅምላ ምርመራ የኮቪድ-19 ስርጭትን ሊገድብ እንደሚችል የሚጠቁም ሞዴል ሰርተዋል፡፡

Source: However, they warned that it would likely be too expensive.
Luganda: Wabula, baalabula nti enkola eyo erabika nga ya bbeeyi nnyo.
Yoruba: Àmọ́ ṣá, wọ́n kílọ̀ pé ṕ lè wọ́n jù.
